verdict.rationale: An on-device ML inference runtime is a fair axis for a game framework, but the evidence pack never documents one for Phaser. The AI-related items cover an MCP server, a hosted Game Agent, and SFX/music generation in the editor. These are AI-assisted authoring tools, not runtime model execution inside the game, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can run ML models inside the game — an official inference runtime for on-device model execution
